Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked leukocytosis and elevated liver enzymes (ALT, AST, ALP), hyperbilirubinemia, and increased globulin, suggesting acute hepatocellular injury or cholestasis, possibly with an inflammatory or infectious process. Mildly elevated hemoglobin may reflect hemoconcentration. Low total CO₂ may indicate mild metabolic acidosis. Renal function, electrolytes, and other parameters are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation and investigation of liver pathology are recommended.
